about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-actions.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

focus and organise.ask: I need a mentor to help me focus and organise my work
focus and organise.reply:
I can find you a mentor right here who can help with that.

{{mentor}}

yes to the first message.ask: Yes please, I’d like a mentor
yes to the first message.reply:
That is great, I can find you a student mentor right here in the chat.
{{mentor}}

help settling in.ask: I’m finding it hard to settle in. Is there someone who could help me?
help settling in.reply:
It can take a little time to feel at home here, but a student mentor can help you settle in and organise your work. 

{{mentor}}

already has one.reply: I can see you already have a mentor assigned to you, and your coordinator will be in touch to introduce you. You can find your mentor's details on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

a mentor themselves.reply: You are signed up as a mentor yourself, so you do not need one.

after not now.reply: Yes, we have [[Chess]] where you can meet other players.

asks after not now.ask: Actually, could you find me a mentor after all?
asks after not now.reply:
I can help you find a mentor right here in the chat.
{{mentor}}
